full_page.content:
1952, March 23
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten message on a holy card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, 0. F. M. Cap. ( from the photo copy)
March 23, 1952 (11 P. M.)
God bless little Marty O'Hara and speed his health back to normality --- God willing
God bless all concerned
Fr. Solanus, 0. F. M. Cap.
Orignial in possession of:
Mrs. Florence O'Haver
36325 Grand River,
Apt. 104
Farmington, Mi. 48024
